name: areios-pagos
description: Hybrid keyword + semantic search over Greek Supreme Court (Άρειος Πάγος) case law, 1994–present.
long_description: Search the published case law of the Άρειος Πάγος (Supreme Court of Greece). Combines Greek full-text keyword search with semantic (vector) search. Tools: search_decisions, get_decision, list_themes, corpus_stats.

mcp_url.title: MCP Server URL
mcp_url.description: Remote areios-pagos MCP endpoint (hosted on the home mini PC, reached over Tailscale).

tools.name: search_decisions
tools.description: Search Areios Pagos decisions (hybrid / keyword / semantic).

tools.name: get_decision
tools.description: Fetch one decision by citation (e.g. 144/2015) or opaque id.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the court's own subject headings (λήμματα).

tools.name: corpus_stats
tools.description: Size and coverage of the local index.
